originalText: {"recordId":"4357a7cb1ae3573159656892","country":"BE","sourceId":"BE-portal","sourceName":"Belgium national procurement","sourceUrl":"https://www.publicprocurement.be/publication-workspaces/da774110-7cfa-4148-88c1-077cf890977e","noticeId":"da774110-7cfa-4148-88c1-077cf890977e|669f075a-e493-4c7e-baf3-cb6c0f5505fa|4","procedureId":"BE-dossier:73827","title":"Agreement for the execution of various topographical tasks involving the Fluxys Belgium pipeline network.","description":"5-year agreement for the execution of various topographical tasks involving the Fluxys Belgium pipeline network. Fluxys Belgium nv. constructs, manages and operates an infrastructure for high-pressure gas transmission by pipeline in Belgium. Actually, this network is about 4 200 km long. The technical and administrative data for this network are given in a database which is used by various departments in the company. This database — which is spatial — plays a key role in the operation of the pipeline network. This means that a lot of importance is attached to the accuracy of the data. The 3-dimensional aspect of the database is mainly the result of topographical surveys. Fluxys Belgium nv mainly uses external surveyors to conduct these surveys.
